Unmodified copies of the weighting-matrix functions from the Bergen EEG-fMRI
Toolbox (BergenToolboxModified, https://github.com/albertleemon/BergenToolboxModified,
originally Moosmann et al. 2009, (c) The Bergen fMRI Group, GPL v2).
They are included only so that the headless pipeline runs without the GUI plugin.
These files remain under GPL v2 (see gpl-v2-license.txt).
